pages.text: $(italic)Graceful and keen-eyed, Elves see perfectly in darkness and move with preternatural speed.$()$(br2)$(bold)Racial Traits:$()$(br2)$(bold)Darkvision$() — $(item)Natural night vision$(). See clearly in dim environments.$(br2)$(bold)Elven Grace$() — $(item)+8% movement speed$(). Permanently faster.$(br2)$(bold)Eagle Eye$() — $(item)+15% ranged damage, +5% magic damage$(). Superior at range and with spells.$(br2)$(bold)Fragile Frame$() — $(warn)-1 armor toughness$(). Slender frames offer less protection.$(br2)$(bold)Refined Palate$() — $(warn)Faster hunger drain$(). High metabolism is the cost of speed.
